local_question: At each original actual selectedSHOCK decision D, what after-fee liquidation difference arises if only SHOCK is disabled for the remainder of that same original position? This is a component action contrast, not a real successor policy or a hold-vs-buy investment return.
checkpoint_and_ON_control: Use the original actual entry E, original buy fill price/quantity/fee, current original D position, entry index, absolute original deadline/reservation and already known pending state. Actual original entry defines the population, not a newly simulated hypothetical BUY.

An ON reconstruction must first reproduce original entry-to-exit decision states and original SELL order/validE/fill/price/quantity/fee exactly, excluding mapped identifiers only. Same last price alone is insufficient.

All original21 events are retained regardless of future OFF matching entry, label sign, year or state group. One equal-weight observation per original cycle; ages and pending retry rows are not new samples.
If SHOCK overlaps another exit, retain that cycle and reproduce the still-active action rather than dropping it. Current original21 have zero such overlaps, but synthetic tests must cover them.
OFF_action_and_execution: Only disable selectedSHOCK action; raw positive-P Z5 condition remains observable. Preserve original costNET1ATR, supportS5, ENTRY_GRACE, priorATR/MA warmup, inherited pending, originalH10 and absolute indices. Do not reset entry age at SHOCK D.

Keep original actual quantity fixed through liquidation, no cash reinvestment, subsequent entry, pause consumption or annual wealth construction. An original later reentry into the real account is irrelevant to this isolated retained old inventory.

Evaluate at D, execute valid nextE using original public resolve_fill and prepared original execution prices/status/limits/tick/T+1/quantity rules. If SELL is blocked retain pending and retry original next sessions, even beyond originalH10; expiry does not guarantee execution.

Stop at original2026-10-15. If liquidation cannot occur by cutoff, price/advantage/sign remain null with censor flag and unresolved reason; do not force close or use later data. Final issued D is10/14 and validE10/15; never invent D10/15 output.

Use runtime fullHFQ feature units and ledger/fill anchoredHFQ units as separately typed roles. Original anchor5.892 converts source price states; public ExecutionPricing and limit/tick projection govern execution. No raw-price assumption or ad-hoc float fill<=limit test.

component_label.formula_perunit: (OFF_exit_price*(1-0.001)-ON_actual_exit_price*(1-0.001))/(original_actual_entry_price*(1+0.001)), with all prices in one original execution representation
component_label.money_crosscheck: ((OFF_Q*OFF_exit_price-OFF_exit_fee)-(ON_Q*ON_exit_price-ON_exit_fee))/(original_Q*entry_price+original_entry_fee). OriginalQ identical. Verify equivalence under original proportional fee contract, not a new account budget.
component_label.sign: Strict positive, exact zero, negative; no selected epsilon or zero-band. Exact same original execution proceeds must yield zero. Any perunit/money sign conflict or projection ambiguity is a technical exception to investigate, not automatic favorable relabeling.
component_label.interpretation: The original entry cost normalizes incremental liquidation value and is not a new profitable-trade label. Entry fees are shared sunk costs; both exits include original sale fees. Keep actual ON fulltrade return distinct if shown as context.
component_label.no_aggregation_as_policy: Do not sum advantages into actual annual return, compound a hypothetical account, count these as trades/frequency, or transfer the original real account's later cash/entry/pause history. A funded changed policy would create its own future population and capital.

proposed_state_review.PRIOR_TREND_ESTABLISHED: Causal if ma20_prior and ma20_prior_lag5 are original source features atD with original warmup, and Close[D-1] comes from original runtime market HFQ at previous trading session. ma20_prior>lag5 and prevClose>=ma20_prior; equality conventions fixed. This reuses old trend information in a new SHOCK decision role, not new independent information.
proposed_state_review.FINAL_DAY_DOMINATES_RET5: Causal atD using original same runtime closes atD,D-1,D-5. Strict log(CD/Cprev)>log(Cprev/CDminus5) compares final day to previous four trading sessions, so strict equality is known false. Use original SHOCK domain and calendar; do not use E gap/open/close or unequal price representations.
proposed_state_review.unknown: Missing, nonpositive or unavailable input is UNKNOWN, not false/zero. Preserve UNKNOWN group; absent year/state cells are null rather than invented zero success.
proposed_state_review.confounding: Both reuse old price inputs and can correlate with Z magnitude, holding age, remainingH10, current netP, regime and year. Report each year's adverse cases and age/horizon overlap. Two-state four cells do not create independent information samples.
proposed_state_review.avoid_new_veto: No CI/sample-count/stability/nonharm hard gate added. N21 and year2022N0 constrain interpretation but are not automatic component rejection. All years already seen; this is shared-history development.

before_any_new_label: Root final method lock binds exact population, formula, unit, cutoff, unknown and censor semantics
Independent synthetic source/execution tests and all21 originalON exact-control PASS

judgment: Method can distinguish localSHOCK action value on the original funded opportunity population. It cannot by itself establish a profitable full policy or explain all cross-year wealth differences. No blocking methodological objection if the explicit control, execution and null/censor conditions are enforced.
